meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Google Chat 消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将应用消息发送到 Google Chat 频道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send app messages to a Google Chat channel.

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 会新增 Google Chat 通道：从 Google Chat 空间接收消息并回复，支持在团队空间或私聊中使用。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 Google Chat 频道集成或设置 Google Chat 通道时触发。

say.text: 请添加 Google Chat 频道集成。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并注册。

say.text: 帮我配置 Google Chat 通道。
say.note: 会引导设置凭据和 webhook。

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 接入 Google Chat。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw gains a Google Chat channel: it can receive messages from Google Chat spaces and reply, enabling conversation via Google Chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Google Chat channel integration or needs to set up a Google Chat channel for NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Please add the Google Chat channel integration.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and registering it.

say_en.text: Help me configure the Google Chat channel.
say_en.note: Guides through credentials and webhook setup.
